# Version constraints for the four distribution-building jobs in release.yml,
# published-artifact-gate.yml and reusable-build-attest.yml.
#
# WHY. The isolated build environment takes the newest setuptools that `[build-system] requires`
# allows, and the wheel records it (`Generator: setuptools (X)` in `*.dist-info/WHEEL`). Measured on
# 2026-10-26 at 58de280a with Python 3.12.15 and build 1.6.1, the way release.yml builds: setuptools
# 84.2.1 gives the wheel ccefd4fd, setuptools 80.9.0 gives b40dc656, the sdist is 202d5cfa in both.
#
# HOW IT IS READ. The four distribution-building jobs in release.yml,
# published-artifact-gate.yml and reusable-build-attest.yml set PIP_CONSTRAINT
# when installing the frontend and when invoking the build script. The two
# release wheel builds also compare the setuptools Generator field with this
# file. That check does not read back the other tool versions or the sdist backend.
#
# These are version constraints, not a hash lock of the build environment.
# Matching the frozen candidate requires comparing the resulting sdist and wheel
# hashes with the candidate hashes before publication.
#
# The five versions below are the resolved set recorded for the measurement on
# 2026-10-26; they are not an inventory of every interpreter or bootstrap component.
build==1.6.1
packaging==26.3
pyproject_hooks==1.3.3
setuptools==84.2.1
wheel==0.48.0
